bio.text: Ethan Baker is the mayor of Troy, Michigan, and serves as an advisory board member for the U.S. Conference of Mayors.
He was the only Republican on the August 2026 primary ballot for Michigan's 11th Congressional District and faces Democrat Jeremy Moss in the November general election.

sources.title: U.S. House, 11th District - Michigan Advance Voter Guide: 2026 Michigan General Election
Moss secures Democratic nomination in Michigan's 11th Congressional District
